set.title: clp Settings
gen.title: General
gen.hk_p: Click the field, then press the keys you want (one of {mods} is required).
gen.pos_p: In apps where the text cursor can't be found (Chrome, VS Code, etc.), the window appears at the mouse position.
gen.auto_p: Keep clp running in the tray after you sign in.
gen.blur_p: When off, the window stays open until you press Esc or paste.
gen.lang_p: To add a language, put a .json file in the locales folder inside the data folder.
look.title: Appearance
look.fs_p: Text size in the history window.
look.shadow_p: Adds a shadow so the window stands out from what's behind it.
look.glass_p: Makes the background translucent and blurs what's behind it.
keys.title: Keys
keys.win_p: Press + then the key you want to assign. Press × to remove one. Each action can have several keys.
keys.bare: In the Snippets tab, paste with a bare digit key when the search box is empty
keys.min1: This action needs at least one key
keys.plain: That would conflict with typing. Combine it with one of {mods}
act.paste_oneline: Paste as one line (line breaks removed)
snip.title: Snippets
snip.empty:
No snippets yet
Click "＋ Add" to create one
snip.ph_title: Title (used in the list and search)
snip.err: snippets.toml has a syntax error. It will be reloaded automatically once you fix the file.
hist.title: History
hist.lim_p: Pinned items are not counted. Changes apply immediately.
hist.excl_p: Anything copied in the apps listed here is not saved to history. One per line, as {hint} (case-insensitive). Useful for password managers.
hist.excl_hint_mac: an app name or bundle ID (e.g. 1password / com.agilebits.onepassword7)
hist.recent_none: (none yet — copy something and it will appear)
hist.clear_p: Currently {n} items. Deletes everything except pinned items (cannot be undone).
about.title: About
about.ver_p: Current version: {v} (checks the latest release on GitHub)
about.updating: Downloading and updating… (clp restarts automatically when done)
about.bk_p: Saves or restores the hotkey, theme, position, history limits and snippets as one JSON file. History contents are not included.
about.import_confirm: Replace the current settings and snippets with the contents of the file?
